rows.definition: A compile-time opt-in CUDA causal prefill kernel that tiles up to four query positions and up to four sibling query heads within one KV head, sharing widened narrowed-format K/V tiles and accumulating online softmax attention. The typed dispatcher selects it only for admitted narrowed-KV geometry under FAK_CUDA_KV16_PREFILL_GQA4_QUALIFICATION.
rows.distinction: This is a specific default-off CUDA kernel, not the general Attention softmax token-mixer or the host attnPrefillGQA3FDotInto kernel. It uses up to four sibling heads and four query positions per block rather than the host three-head traversal; the existing explicit tile4 branch has priority. Source and host build-selection checks do not establish native numerical correctness, device execution or speedup.
